product.olivetti-prodest-pc128s.summary: The Acorn-derived Prodest with a separate disk unit and BBC BASIC.
product.olivetti-prodest-pc128s.history: Olivetti marketed Acorn’s BBC Master Compact in Italy as the Prodest PC 128 S, with a localised manual and welcome disk. The Italian guide is dated September 1986. It extended the Prodest home range with the Acorn platform and a separate disk unit.
product.olivetti-prodest-pc128s.architec: The system could load the Welcome disk with Shift and Break. The guide documents this boot path and ADFS. MAME records MOS I5.10C in the 64 KiB mos510o.ic49, with a 2 MHz 65SC12.
product.olivetti-prodest-pc128s.verified: The manual was checked against the MAME pro128s definition. BluMach validation is pending. MAME flags graphics limitations.
product.olivetti-prodest-pc128s.limitati: ROM verification and functional tests are pending.
product.olivetti-prodest-pc128s.manual: Olivetti Prodest, Guida all’uso del sistema PC 128 S, DC 5040, v1.0, 09/1986.
